name: Example prompt
text:
The video is a single continuous shot lasting approximately 8 seconds in a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. The camera is a fixed smartphone camera with subtle natural movement. There are no cuts or visual discontinuities.

00:00 The subject looks directly into the camera with a neutral expression.

00:01 The subject begins speaking at a natural conversational pace: "Hello there."

00:02 The subject maintains eye contact and gently smiles.

00:04 The subject continues speaking: "This is the second line."

00:06 The subject pauses briefly while maintaining the smile.

00:08 The video ends abruptly.
